adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: The code shows `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is undefined/null, the fallback logic tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `cal.externalId === undefined`), which will never match any valid calendar. This is a logical bug - the fallback should likely use a different criteria (like credentialId) rather than comparing to the undefined externalCalendarId. The same bug pattern appears in deleteEvent at line 314-316.
